item.title: A Solar Optical Clock
item.description: arXiv:2610.28485v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Precision spectroscopy underpins quantum sensing, atomic timekeeping, and the search for terrestrial-mass exoplanets. Finding an Earth-Sun analog requires fractional splitting of spectral features that rivals the precision of the best laboratory spectroscopy. item.title: Intermolecular decoupling of C<sub>60</sub> suppresses interfacial recombination in perovskite solar cells
item.description: Nature Photonics, Published online: 13 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-02030-x Interfacial recombination in perovskite solar cells is mitigated through a vapour-phase molecular passivation method using trialkylamines, disrupting C60 packing. This approach results in a power conversion efficiency of up to 27.2% while maintaining stability.

item.title: Solid-state emissive acceptors enable thermally accessible radiative pathways for efficient organic solar cells
item.description: Nature Photonics, Published online: 12 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-02009-8 Solid-state emissive guest acceptors enhance organic solar cells by establishing thermally accessible radiative pathways, significantly reducing non-radiative voltage loss end enabling ternary blend devices with a certified power conversion efficiency of 20.84%.
